title: Atlas first integrated Meridian prototype architecture and public/private integration-boundary plan
uncertainty: What precise local application boundary, bounded user experience and audit-dependent transition sequence should connect the demonstrated public Atlas runtime to a clean first Meridian application prototype?
importance: The qualified regional runtime is ready for a narrow application integration; more evidence-family research is not a prerequisite. Plan the transition without assuming private application architecture or weakening scientific meaning.
prerequisites: Completed habitat/planning integration and prototype-readiness assessment
Public runtime/library/CLI contracts, generation pinning and retained rights/coverage boundaries
No private repository access is authorized by this task
scope: Use public code/documentation only to specify an Exe evidence explorer and optional explicit Tryfan/Riffelhorn region selection
Select the minimum publication-selection/query/qualified-document/display-geometry boundary, Node versus browser separation and local communication/export strategy
Identify reusable public frontend patterns in principle, retained data/setup and packaging responsibilities
Record decisions that require a later explicitly authorized private repository audit; do not inspect, modify or migrate the private repository
Define bounded implementation acceptance, protected public assets, rollback and data/rights boundaries; do not implement the prototype
deliverables: One concrete first-prototype architecture and integration-boundary plan
Stable minimal DTO/module ownership and user-experience specification
Permission-gated audit and transition prerequisites plus one next bounded task
acceptance: Concrete narrow user experience, region/population/coverage and non-claims specified
Canonical files/root and scientific contracts remain authoritative; application never presents SQL/index/rendering as truth
Node/Python runtime and browser UI boundary is explicit with pinned historical generation, qualifications and provenance
Rights, unknown time, missing evidence, CRS/display conversion and unavailable data behavior specified
Private architecture remains unassumed; any audit/access/migration requires separate explicit authorization
No another evidence-family integration or optimisation added merely because available
stop: Stop after the public-only transition plan, readiness prerequisites and exactly one unbegun subsequent task; no private access, application implementation, production modification or service work.
